high_level_description: The image is a tweet from Lawrence Wong, who is verified on Twitter (@LawrenceWongST). The tweet reads: "Welcome PM @narendramodi to Singapore! Delighted to have the chance to catch up over a meal at the Istana, before the official meetings tomorrow." The photo accompanying the tweet shows two men standing together in what appears to be an outdoor corridor or veranda of a building. The man on the left is wearing a patterned batik shirt and dark pants, while the man on the right is dressed in a dark green vest with a pocket square and a white shirt underneath. Both men are smiling
